info.title: CashOrTrash API
info.description: Price-guessing game API. `truePriceCents` is returned by exactly one endpoint: POST /sessions/:id/rounds/:index/bet.

deviceId.description:
Client-generated, stable per install. Re-posting the same id returns the
same player, which is what makes a reinstall-free app relaunch seamless.

isNewPlayer.description: Set on first sight of a device.

username.description: Null until the name is claimed.

challengeDate.description: The UTC challenge day this describes.

roundsPlayed.description: Rounds already bet on today, 0 if none.

complete.description: True once every round has been played.

challengeDate.description: The UTC challenge day the round belongs to.

loCents.description: The bet’s low edge, minor units.

hiCents.description: The bet’s high edge, minor units.

truePriceCents.description: What it actually went for, minor units.

streakDays.description: Zero once the streak lapses, whatever is stored.

dailyProgress.description: Progress through today’s challenge. Present even before it is started, so a client can render "Play" and "Continue · round 3" from one answer.

lastDailyMiss.description: The round of the last finished daily before today that the player was furthest off on, relative to the price. Null with no finished daily behind them, or one they hit every round of.

normalised.description: The handle as it would be stored.

reason.description: Player-facing copy for the inline hint; null when available.

code.description: Stable slug for the client to pick its own copy from; null when available.

rate.description: Units of this currency to one US dollar. Always 1 for USD.

asOf.description: When the provider published this rate. The epoch means no live fetch has landed yet and the configured fallback is standing in.

isMe.description: True for the requesting player’s own row.

rank.description: Null when the player has no score yet.

delta.description: Yesterday’s final rank minus today’s live rank; the "▲ 41" tag.

percentile.description: Percent of players beaten, 0–100. Null when unranked.

neighbours.description: The rows either side of the player, for the neighbour strip.

tiedAtTop.description: How many players share the top score — 1 when first place is undisputed, 0 on an empty board. Lets a client caption a tied podium.

iconName.description: Glyph for the card. A name from a fixed set the client ships; anything else it does not recognise falls back to its default.

isMystery.description: Mystery mix draws from every theme.

difficultyLabel.description: Null until the theme has enough rounds to be honest about.

itemCount.description: Playable item count; a theme needs at least 5.

themeSlug.description: Required for quick and h2h rounds; ignored for daily, which has no theme picker.

currentIndex.description: Index of the next unplayed round.

resumed.description: True when an in-progress session was returned.

max.description: Multiplier at or below `narrowWidthPct` — the narrow end.

min.description: Multiplier at or above `wideWidthPct` — the wide end.

narrowWidthPct.description: Bet width, as a share of the slider, that earns `max`.

wideWidthPct.description: Bet width, as a share of the slider, that earns `min`.

decimals.description: Decimals the multiplier is rounded to before it is applied. Rounded before, not after, so the arithmetic on the reveal is the arithmetic the player watched.

scoringVersion.description: Which constant set produced this curve.

currency.description: The currency every amount below is in.

incrementCents.description: Slider step, in cents. Bets must land on it.

totalScore.description: Running total going into this round.

roundSeconds.description: Seconds allowed on this round, from when the server dealt it. 0 means the shot clock is off.

expiresAt.description: Server-side deadline. Null when the clock is off. Informational — a client should count `remainingMs` down rather than compare this against its own clock.

remainingMs.description: Milliseconds left when this response was built; count down from here. 0 means the round is already lost — re-fetching does not reset it, because the deadline is stamped once, when the round is first dealt. Null when the clock is off.

multiplierCurve.description: The multiplier curve this round will be scored on. Sent because the gameplay slider has to label the bet while the player is dragging it, which is the one scoring decision a round trip cannot make. It travels with the round rather than being fetched once, so it is always the curve this round is actually scored on — see `scoringVersion`.

loCents.description: Lower bound, in cents, snapped to the increment.

hiCents.description: Upper bound, in cents, snapped to the increment.

currency.description: The currency the two bounds are expressed in. Must be the same one the round was dealt in — the bet is validated against that currency’s slider grid, then converted back to dollars to be scored.

timedOut.description: The bet reached the server after the round’s deadline and scored nothing. `hit` is false on such a round even when the range did contain the price — compare `truePriceCents` against the bounds to say so.

elapsedMs.description: Server-measured milliseconds spent on the round.

missedByCents.description: Cents between the guess and the price; 0 on a hit.

errorPct.description: Signed relative error of the range centre.

opponentRoundPoints.description: Points the opponent scored on this round, once they have played.

currency.description: The currency every amount below, and inside `round`, is in.

nextRoundIndex.description: Null when the session is over.

replayed.description: True when this response replayed an already-recorded bet.

hits.description: Ranges hit, out of roundCount. The "2/5" circle.

currency.description: The currency the amounts inside `rounds` are in.

percentile.description: "You beat 78% of today’s players" — the share of the *other* players scored below this one. Daily sessions only.

rank.description: Competition rank on the day’s board: one more than the number of players strictly ahead, so a tie shares a place. Null wherever `percentile` is.

sharedWith.description: How many other players sit on exactly this score. Sent so a client can say "tied for first" instead of "you beat 0%", which is what a three-way tie at the top reads as otherwise.

rankDelta.description: Places gained on the day’s board against yesterday’s final standings (positive = up). Null on the first day played, or wherever `rank` is.

leaderboardEligible.description: False when this daily score was kept off the board because the account is still inside its probation window. The score still counts toward the player’s own totals and streak; it just does not rank. True everywhere else, including on modes that are not ranked at all — so a client can read it as "is there a reason there is no rank" rather than as a mode test. Sent because an unranked new account and a board that has not answered yet both arrive as a null percentile, and only one of them is worth explaining to the player.

shareText.description: Prefilled copy for the Share result button.

score.description: Rounds won, not points — the match is best of 5.

roundsPlayed.description: Rounds this player has already bet on.

online.description: Connected to the match socket right now.

winnerUserId.description: Null while in progress or on a draw.

streakDays.description: Zero once the streak lapses, whatever is stored.

username.description:
By handle, not by id. A player reads a username off a friend's screen or a
shared result; they never see the numeric id, and accepting one here would
turn the endpoint into an enumeration primitive for the whole user table.

timezoneOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes east of UTC. Buckets the nudge so it lands in the player’s evening.

locale.description: The language to send this device’s nudges in. Push copy is composed on the server long after the app last ran, so it cannot be read from the request that receives it.

streakDays.description: Your streak. Zero once it lapses.

globalRank.description: Global rank, or null if unranked.

resetsAt.description: The instant the challenge rolls over, UTC.

secondsUntilReset.description: Drives "resets in 6h 12m" without a client clock.

roundsPlayed.description: Rounds already played today — the progress dots.

ctaLabel.description: Contextual label for the hero button.

catalog.description: Version of GET /themes. Moves whenever that payload would differ — a category appearing or being retired, a difficulty label changing, or any item being added or removed, since the mystery row carries a count of the whole catalogue.

currency.description: Version of GET /currencies. Moves when a rate is refreshed, which is hourly at most.
